title: Senior Full Stack (Dot NET & REACT JS) Developer
description:
**Senior Full Stack (Dot NET \& REACT JS) Developer** :

**Experience:** 5\+ Years

**Role:** Full Stack Developer

**Technology:** .NET / C\# / React / SQL Server / Web API

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Full Stack .NET \+ React Developer with 5\+ years of experience** to design, develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise applications.

The candidate should have strong experience in **C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, React, and SQL Server**, along with a good understanding of **Clean Architecture, Layered Architecture, REST APIs, and object\-oriented programming**.

The candidate will work on existing applications as well as new feature development, bug fixing, performance improvements, API integrations, and production support/development activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain applications using **C\#, .NET / ASP.NET Core, Web API, and React**.
* Develop reusable, scalable, and maintainable backend and frontend components.
* Work with existing **Clean Architecture and Layered Architecture** based applications.
* Work on **RESTful Web APIs**.
* Design and implement business logic, services, repositories, and API endpoints.
* Develop responsive and user\-friendly interfaces using **React.js**.
* Integrate React applications with .NET Web APIs.
* Work with **SQL Server**, including queries, stored procedures, joins, views, and database optimization.
* Implement authentication, authorization, validation, exception handling, and logging.
* Analyze and troubleshoot application, API, database, and integration issues.
* Perform code reviews and follow coding standards and best practices.
* Write unit tests and participate in integration and functional testing.
* Work with existing codebases and understand the impact of changes across different application layers.
* Collaborate with business analysts, QA teams, DevOps teams, and other developers.
* Participate in deployment, issue investigation, and application maintenance activities.
* Identify performance and scalability improvements and implement appropriate solutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Backend** :

* 5\+ years of experience in **.NET / C\# development**.
* Strong knowledge of **ASP.NET Core / .NET Web API**.
* Good understanding of **MVC architecture**.
* Strong knowledge of **OOP, SOLID principles, Design Patterns, and Dependency Injection**.
* Experience with **RESTful APIs and third\-party API integrations**.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, exception handling, logging, and API security.

**Frontend**

* Strong experience with **React.js**.
* Good knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS.
* Experience with React components, hooks, state management, API integration, and form validation.
* Understanding of frontend performance and reusable component development.

**Architecture**

* Good understanding of **Clean Architecture** and **Layered Architecture**.
* Ability to work with applications containing separate **API, Business, Data Access, Domain/Entity, and UI layers**.

Ability to understand and work with existing architecture and coding standards

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
